_notes: three.js conventions: Y up, right-handed, metres, ground plane y=0. Camera at (0,h,0), receding street along -Z. camera.rotationEuler = [x,y,z] radians, order 'YXZ' (yaw about Y, pitch about X, roll 0); lookAt is an equivalent target. fovVertical in degrees (three.js PerspectiveCamera.fov), derived from a 35 mm lens on 36 mm sensor width (horizontal fov) at 16:9. Proxy box: center, size [x,y,z] full extents, rotationY radians. Cylinder: center (middle), radius, height. walkable: polygons of [x,z] in metres on y=0; holes are footprints to avoid (bench incl. legs with 0.25 m margin, lamp post with 0.3 m margin). Scale from bench seat height 0.45 m (near feet ground row 537.5 px, seat near-edge top row 452.5 px). Fence posts and curb top edges assumed on a 0.15 m curb. Marker facing: facingY radians about Y for a model whose forward is +Z (glTF); bench_sit faces AWAY from the camera (facingY = pi, facing -Z; the bench is painted seen from behind); position = seat centre at seat height, approach = standing point on the far side of the bench, in front of the seat. Proxy "mask": file in /plates/ (1280x720, white = object); the app discards proxy fragments where the mask is black, in screen space. sun.direction: unit vector from the scene toward the sun. Character height later: 1.28 m. Hand-read pixel coordinates are in tools/maps/plate_01.json. exits: [{name, zone: polygon [[x,z],...] on the ground inside the walkable area, to: target map id, arrival: arrival name in the target map}]; the character entering a zone leaves the map. arrivals: [{name, position: [x,z], facingY}] spawn points; facingY radians about Y, model forward +Z (glTF), same convention as markers (0 = faces +Z, toward the camera on a street map; pi = faces -Z). Arrival 'start' is the default spawn. Every arrival is inside the walkable area, outside every exit zone, at least 0.5 m from zones, holes and the walkable edge (checked by build_scene.py).

camera.rollAssumed: 0 (horizon not visibly tilted; left/right rails converge symmetrically)
